baseitem.name: Alchemist's Supplies
additionalEntries: Alchemist's supplies enable a character to produce useful concoctions, such as acid or alchemist's fire.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Alchemist's supplies include two glass beakers, a metal frame to hold a beaker in place over an open flame, a glass stirring rod, a small mortar and pestle, and a pouch of common alchemical ingredients, including salt, powdered iron, and purified water.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana
entries: Proficiency with alchemist's supplies allows you to unlock more information on {@skill Arcana} checks involving potions and similar materials.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: When you inspect an area for clues, proficiency with alchemist's supplies grants additional insight into any chemicals or other substances that might have been used in the area.

additionalEntries.name: Alchemical Crafting
entries: You can use this tool proficiency to create alchemical items. A character can spend money to collect raw materials, which weigh 1 pound for every 50 gp spent. The DM can allow a character to make a check using the indicated skill with advantage. As part of a long rest, you can use alchemist's supplies to make one dose of {@item acid (vial)|phb|acid}, {@item alchemist's fire (flask)|phb|alchemist's fire}, {@item antitoxin (vial)|phb|antitoxin}, {@item oil (flask)|phb|oil}, {@item perfume (vial)|phb|perfume}, or {@item soap|phb}. Subtract half the value of the created item from the total gp worth of raw materials you are carrying.

additionalEntries.caption: Alchemist's Supplies
rows: Create a puff of thick smoke
Identify a poison
Identify a substance
Start a fire
Neutralize acid

entries: Intelligence

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Identify a substance ({@dc 15}), or start a fire ({@dc 15})

baseitem.name: Arrow
entries: Arrows are used with a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.
Arrows are typically stored in a {@item Quiver|XPHB} (bought separately).

baseitem.name: Birdpipes
entries: Pan pipes or satyr pipes, also known as the shalm, these are sacred to {@deity Lliira|Faerûnian|scag} and popular with wood elf and wild elf bards.

Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.
Bolts are typically stored in a {@item Crossbow Bolt Case|XPHB} (bought separately).

Bolts are typically stored in a {@item Crossbow Bolt Case|XPHB} (bought separately).

baseitem.name: Breastplate
entries: Esta armadura consiste em uma peça de metal ajustada no peito, usada com couro macio. Embora deixe as pernas e os braços relativamente desprotegidos, esta armadura oferece boa proteção para os órgãos vitais do usuário, enquanto o mantém relativamente desimpedido.

baseitem.name: Brewer's Supplies
additionalEntries: Brewing is the art of producing beer. Not only does beer serve as an alcoholic beverage, but the process of brewing purifies water. Crafting beer takes weeks of fermentation, but only a few hours of work.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Brewer's supplies include a large glass jug, a quantity of hops, a siphon, and several feet of tubing.

additionalEntries.name: History
entries: Proficiency with brewer's supplies gives you additional insight on Intelligence ({@skill History}) checks concerning events that involve alcohol as a significant element.

additionalEntries.name: Medicine
entries: This tool proficiency grants additional insight when you treat anyone suffering from alcohol poisoning or when you can use alcohol to dull pain.

additionalEntries.name: Persuasion
entries: A stiff drink can help soften the hardest heart. Your proficiency with brewer's supplies can help you ply someone with drink, giving them just enough alcohol to mellow their mood.

additionalEntries.name: Potable Water
entries: Your knowledge of brewing enables you to purify water that would otherwise be undrinkable. As part of a long rest, you can purify up to 6 gallons of water, or 1 gallon as part of a short rest.

additionalEntries.caption: Brewer's Supplies
rows: Detect poison or impurities in a drink
Identify alcohol
Ignore effects of alcohol

baseitem.name: Calligrapher's Supplies
additionalEntries: A caligrafia trata a escrita como uma arte delicada e bela. Calígrafos produzem textos que são agradáveis aos olhos, utilizando um estilo que é difícil de falsificar. Seus suprimentos também lhes conferem alguma habilidade para examinar manuscritos e determinar se são legítimos, uma vez que o treinamento de um calígrafo envolve longas horas de estudo da escrita e tentativas de replicar seu estilo e design.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: Os suprimentos de caligrafia incluem tinta, uma dúzia de folhas de pergaminho e três penas.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana
entries: Embora a caligrafia seja de pouca ajuda para decifrar o conteúdo de escritos mágicos, a proficiência com esses suprimentos pode ajudar a identificar quem escreveu um manuscrito de natureza mágica.

additionalEntries.name: História
entries: Essa proficiência em ferramentas pode aumentar o benefício de testes bem-sucedidos feitos para analisar ou investigar escritos antigos, pergaminhos ou outros textos, incluindo runas gravadas em pedra ou mensagens em afrescos ou outras exibições.

additionalEntries.name: Decifrar Mapa do Tesouro
entries: Essa proficiência em ferramentas concede a você especialização em examinar mapas. Você pode fazer um teste de Inteligência para determinar a idade de um mapa, se um mapa inclui mensagens ocultas ou fatos semelhantes.

additionalEntries.caption: Suprimentos de Caligrafia
rows: Identificar o autor de um manuscrito não mágico
Determinar o estado de espírito do autor
Identificar texto falsificado
Falsificar uma assinatura

entries: Write text with impressive flourishes that guard against forgery ({@dc 15})

baseitem.name: Carpenter's Tools
additionalEntries: Skill at carpentry enables a character to construct wooden structures. A carpenter can build a house, a shack, a wooden cabinet, or similar items.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Carpenter's tools include a saw, a hammer, nails, a hatchet, a square, a ruler, an adze, a plane, and a chisel.

additionalEntries.name: History
entries: This tool proficiency aids you in identifying the use and the origin of wooden buildings and other large wooden objects.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: You gain additional insight when inspecting areas within wooden structures, because you know tricks of construction that can conceal areas from discovery.

additionalEntries.name: Perception
entries: You can spot irregularities in wooden walls or floors, making it easier to find trap doors and secret passages.

additionalEntries.name: Stealth
entries: You can quickly assess the weak spots in a wooden floor, making it easier to avoid the places that creak and groan when they're stepped on.

additionalEntries.name: Fortify
entries: With 1 minute of work and raw materials, you can make a door or window harder to force open. Increase the DC needed to open it by 5.

additionalEntries.name: Temporary Shelter
entries: As part of a long rest, you can construct a lean-to or a similar shelter to keep your group dry and in the shade for the duration of the rest. Because it was fashioned quickly from whatever wood was available, the shelter collapses {@dice 1d3} days after being assembled.

additionalEntries.caption: Carpenter's Tools
rows: Build a simple wooden structure
Design a complex wooden structure
Find a weak point in a wooden wall
Pry apart a door

entries: Strength

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Seal or pry open a door or container ({@dc 20})

baseitem.name: Cartographer's Tools
additionalEntries: Usando as ferramentas de cartografia, você pode criar mapas precisos para facilitar a viagem para si mesmo e para aqueles que vierem depois de você. Esses mapas podem variar desde representações em grande escala de cadeias de montanhas até diagramas que mostram a disposição de um nível de masmorras.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: As ferramentas de cartografia consistem em uma pena, tinta, pergaminho, um par de compasses, calipers e uma régua.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, História, Religião
entries: Você pode usar seu conhecimento sobre mapas e locais para descobrir informações mais detalhadas ao usar essas habilidades. Por exemplo, você pode notar mensagens ocultas em um mapa, identificar quando o mapa foi feito para determinar se características geográficas mudaram desde então, e assim por diante.

additionalEntries.name: Natureza
entries: Sua familiaridade com a geografia física torna mais fácil para você responder perguntas ou resolver questões relacionadas ao terreno ao seu redor.

additionalEntries.name: Sobrevivência
entries: Sua compreensão da geografia facilita encontrar caminhos para a civilização, prever áreas onde vilas ou cidades podem ser encontradas e evitar se perder. Você estudou tantos mapas que padrões comuns, como a evolução das rotas comerciais e onde os assentamentos surgem em relação a locais geográficos, são familiares para você.

additionalEntries.name: Criar um Mapa
entries: Enquanto viaja, você pode desenhar um mapa à medida que avança, além de se envolver em outras atividades.

additionalEntries.caption: Ferramentas de Cartografia
rows: Determinar a idade e a origem de um mapa
Estimar direção e distância até um marco
Discernir que um mapa é falso
Preencher uma parte faltante de um mapa

baseitem.name: Chain Mail
entries: Feita de anéis de metal interligados, a cota de malha inclui uma camada de tecido acolchoado usada por baixo da malha para evitar atrito e para amortecer o impacto dos golpes. A armadura inclui manoplas.

baseitem.name: Chain Shirt
entries: Feita de anéis de metal interligados, uma camisa de corrente é usada entre camadas de roupas ou couro. Esta armadura oferece proteção modesta para a parte superior do corpo do usuário e permite que o som dos anéis se esfregando uns contra os outros seja abafado por camadas externas.

baseitem.name: Cobbler's Tools
additionalEntries: Although the cobbler's trade might seem too humble for an adventurer, a good pair of boots will see a character across rugged wilderness and through deadly dungeons.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Cobbler's tools consist of a hammer, an awl, a knife, a shoe stand, a cutter, spare leather, and thread.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, History
entries: Your knowledge of shoes aids you in identifying the magical properties of enchanted boots or the history of such items.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: Footwear holds a surprising number of secrets. You can learn where someone has recently visited by examining the wear and the dirt that has accumulated on their shoes. Your experience in repairing shoes makes it easier for you to identify where damage might come from.

additionalEntries.name: Maintain Shoes
entries: As part of a long rest, you can repair your companions' shoes. For the next 24 hours, up to six creatures of your choice who wear shoes you worked on can travel up to 10 hours a day without making saving throws to avoid {@condition exhaustion}.

additionalEntries.name: Craft Hidden Compartment
entries: With 8 hours of work, you can add a hidden compartment to a pair of shoes. The compartment can hold an object up to 3 inches long and 1 inch wide and deep. You make an Intelligence check using your tool proficiency to determine the Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check DC needed to find the compartment.

additionalEntries.caption: Cobbler's Tools
rows: Determine a shoe's age and origin
Find a hidden compartment in a boot heel

baseitem.name: Cook's Utensils
additionalEntries: Aventurar-se é uma vida difícil. Com um cozinheiro ao longo da jornada, suas refeições serão muito melhores do que a mistura típica de biscoitos duros e frutas secas.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: Utensílios de cozinheiro incluem uma panela de metal, facas, garfos, uma colher de mexer e uma concha.

additionalEntries.name: História
entries: Seu conhecimento de técnicas de culinária permite que você avalie os padrões sociais envolvidos nos hábitos alimentares de uma cultura.

additionalEntries.name: Medicina
entries: Ao administrar tratamento, você pode transformar remédios que são amargos ou azedos em uma mistura agradável.

additionalEntries.name: Sobrevivência
entries: Ao forragear por comida, você pode se virar com ingredientes que você encontra e que outros não conseguiriam transformar em refeições nutritivas.

additionalEntries.name: Preparar Refeições
entries: Como parte de um descanso curto, você pode preparar uma refeição saborosa que ajuda seus companheiros a recuperar suas forças. Você e até cinco criaturas de sua escolha recuperam 1 ponto de vida extra por dado de vida gasto durante um descanso curto, desde que você tenha acesso aos seus utensílios de cozinheiro e comida suficiente.

additionalEntries.caption: Utensílios de Cozinheiro
rows: Criar uma refeição típica
Duplicar uma refeição
Identificar veneno ou impurezas na comida
Criar uma refeição gourmet

baseitem.name: Glassblower's Tools
additionalEntries: Alguém que é proficiente com ferramentas de vidraceiro não apenas tem a habilidade de moldar vidro, mas também conhecimento especializado dos métodos usados para produzir objetos de vidro.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: As ferramentas incluem um canudo, um pequeno marver, blocos e pinças. Você precisa de uma fonte de calor para trabalhar com vidro.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, História
entries: Seu conhecimento das técnicas de fabricação de vidro ajuda você quando examina objetos de vidro, como frascos de poção ou itens de vidro encontrados em um tesouro. Por exemplo, você pode estudar como um frasco de poção de vidro foi alterado por seu conteúdo para ajudar a determinar os efeitos de uma poção. (Uma poção pode deixar um resíduo, deformar o vidro ou manchá-lo.)

additionalEntries.name: Investigação
entries: Quando você estuda uma área, seu conhecimento pode ajudar se as pistas incluírem vidro quebrado ou objetos de vidro.

additionalEntries.name: Identificar Fraquezas
entries: Com 1 minuto de estudo, você pode identificar os pontos fracos em um objeto de vidro. Qualquer dano causado ao objeto ao atingir um ponto fraco é dobrado.

additionalEntries.caption: Ferramentas de Vidraceiro
rows: Identificar a fonte do vidro
Determinar o que um objeto de vidro continha

baseitem.name: Glaur
entries: Chifres curtos e curvados como uma cornucópia. Tocados com válvulas, os glaur soam como trompetes, enquanto aqueles sem válvulas, conhecidos como gloon, têm um som mais triste.

baseitem.name: Half Plate Armor
entries: A meia-armadura consiste em placas de metal moldadas que cobrem a maior parte do corpo do usuário. Ela não inclui proteção para as pernas além de simples grevas que são presas com tiras de couro.

baseitem.name: Hand Drum
entries: Um tambor de pele de duas cabeças equipado com alças ao longo de seu lado.

baseitem.name: Hide Armor
entries: Esta armadura rudimentar consiste em peles e pelagens grossas. É comumente usada por tribos bárbaras, humanoides malignos e outros povos que não têm acesso às ferramentas e materiais necessários para criar armaduras melhores.

baseitem.name: Hooked Shortspear
entries: On a hit with this weapon, the wielder can forgo dealing damage and attempt to trip the target, in which case the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. The DC is 8 + the wielder's Strength modifier + the wielder's proficiency bonus.

baseitem.name: Hoopak
entries: A hoopak is a sturdy stick with a sling at one end and a pointed tip at the other.

entries.name: Special
entries: When you make a melee attack with this weapon, you ignore its ammunition property. You can use the hoopak as a martial ranged weapon. If you do, it uses the ammunition property, uses sling bullets, and deals {@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage on a hit.

baseitem.name: Jeweler's Tools
additionalEntries: Training with jeweler's tools includes the basic techniques needed to beautify gems. It also gives you expertise in identifying precious stones.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Jeweler's tools consist of a small saw and hammer, files, pliers, and tweezers.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana
entries: Proficiency with jeweler's tools grants you knowledge about the reputed mystical uses of gems. This insight proves handy when you make {@skill Arcana} checks related to gems or gem-encrusted items.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: When you inspect jeweled objects, your proficiency with jeweler's tools aids you in picking out clues they might hold.

additionalEntries.name: Identify Gems
entries: You can identify gems and determine their value at a glance.

additionalEntries.caption: Jeweler's Tools

entries: Você tem desvantagem ao usar uma lança para atacar um alvo a até 1,5 metros de você. Além disso, uma lança requer duas mãos para ser empunhada quando você não está montado.

baseitem.name: Lance
entries: A Lance requires two hands to wield when you aren't mounted.

baseitem.name: Leather Armor
entries: A couraça e os protetores de ombro desta armadura são feitos de couro que foi endurecido por ter sido fervido em óleo. O restante da armadura é feito de materiais mais macios e flexíveis.

baseitem.name: Leatherworker's Tools
additionalEntries: O conhecimento sobre marcenaria de couro se estende à lore relacionada a peles de animais e suas propriedades. Ele também confere conhecimento sobre armaduras de couro e bens similares.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: As ferramentas de marcenaria de couro incluem uma faca, um pequeno martelo, um cortador, um perfurador, linha e retalhos de couro.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana
entries: Sua especialização em trabalhar com couro lhe concede uma percepção adicional ao inspecionar itens mágicos feitos de couro, como botas e algumas capas.

additionalEntries.name: Investigação
entries: Você ganha uma percepção adicional ao estudar itens de couro ou pistas relacionadas a eles, pois utiliza seu conhecimento sobre couro para identificar detalhes que outros poderiam ignorar.

additionalEntries.name: Identificar Peles
entries: Ao olhar para uma pele ou um item de couro, você pode determinar a origem do couro e quaisquer técnicas especiais usadas para tratá-lo. Por exemplo, você pode notar a diferença entre couro feito usando métodos anões e couro feito usando métodos halflings.

additionalEntries.caption: Ferramentas de Marcenaria de Couro
rows: Modificar a aparência de um item de couro
Determinar a história de um item de couro

entries: Esta besta é equipada com um cartucho que pode conter até seis virotes de besta. Ela recarrega automaticamente após disparar até que o cartucho fique sem munição. Recarregar o cartucho leva uma ação.

baseitem.name: Longhorn
entries: Uma flauta faeruniana de fabricação sofisticada, encontrada apenas em áreas com artesãos habilidosos, como em grandes cidades ou enclaves élficos.

baseitem.name: Mason's Tools
additionalEntries: As ferramentas de pedreiro permitem que você crie estruturas de pedra, incluindo paredes e edifícios feitos de tijolos.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: As ferramentas de pedreiro consistem em uma colher de pedreiro, um martelo, um cinzel, pincéis e um esquadro.

additionalEntries.name: História
entries: Sua experiência ajuda você a identificar a data de construção e o propósito de um edifício de pedra, além de fornecer informações sobre quem pode tê-lo construído.

additionalEntries.name: Investigação
entries: Você ganha uma percepção adicional ao inspecionar áreas dentro de estruturas de pedra.

additionalEntries.name: Percepção
entries: Você pode notar irregularidades em paredes ou pisos de pedra, facilitando a localização de portas ocultas e passagens secretas.

additionalEntries.name: Demolição
entries: Seu conhecimento de alvenaria permite que você identifique pontos fracos em paredes de tijolos. Você causa o dobro de dano a essas estruturas com seus ataques de arma.

Encontrar um ponto fraco em uma parede de pedra

baseitem.name: Needle
entries: Blowgun needles are used with a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.
Needles are typically stored in a {@item Pouch|XPHB} (bought separately).

baseitem.name: Needles (50)
entries: Blowgun needles are used with a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.
Needles are typically stored in a {@item Pouch|XPHB} (bought separately).

entries.name: Special
entries: A Large or smaller creature hit by a net is {@condition restrained} until it is freed. A net has no effect on creatures that are formless, or creatures that are Huge or larger. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 10} Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) also frees the creature without harming it, ending the effect and destroying the net. When you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to attack with a net, you can make only one attack regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

baseitem.name: Padded Armor
entries: A armadura acolchoada consiste em camadas acolchoadas de tecido e enchimento.

baseitem.name: Painter's Supplies
additionalEntries: A proficiência com materiais de pintura representa sua habilidade de pintar e desenhar. Você também adquire um entendimento da história da arte, o que pode ajudá-lo a examinar obras de arte.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: Os materiais de pintura incluem um cavalete, tela, tintas, pincéis, bastões de carvão e uma paleta.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, História, Religião
entries: Sua especialização ajuda você a descobrir conhecimentos de qualquer tipo que estejam ligados a uma obra de arte, como as propriedades mágicas de uma pintura ou as origens de um estranho mural encontrado em uma masmorra.

additionalEntries.name: Investigação, Percepção
entries: Quando você inspeciona uma pintura ou uma obra de arte visual semelhante, seu conhecimento das práticas por trás de sua criação pode lhe conceder uma visão adicional.

additionalEntries.name: Pintura e Desenho
entries: Como parte de um descanso curto ou longo, você pode produzir uma obra de arte simples. Embora seu trabalho possa carecer de precisão, você pode capturar uma imagem ou uma cena, ou fazer uma cópia rápida de uma obra de arte que viu.

additionalEntries.caption: Materiais de Pintura
rows: Pintar um retrato preciso
Criar uma pintura com uma mensagem oculta

items.name: Ability:
entries: Wisdom

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Paint a recognizable image of something you've seen ({@dc 10})

items.name: Craft:
entries: {@item Druidic Focus|XPHB}, {@item Holy Symbol|XPHB}

items.name: Ability:
entries: Charisma

items.name: Utilize:

baseitem.name: Plate Armor
entries: A armadura pesada consiste em placas de metal moldadas e interligadas para cobrir todo o corpo. Um conjunto de armadura pesada inclui manoplas, botas de couro pesado, um capacete com visor e camadas espessas de acolchoamento sob a armadura. Fivelas e tiras distribuem o peso pelo corpo.

baseitem.name: Potter's Tools
additionalEntries: Ferramentas de oleiro são usadas para criar uma variedade de objetos cerâmicos, tipicamente potes e recipientes semelhantes.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: As ferramentas de oleiro incluem agulhas de oleiro, costelas, raspadores, uma faca e paquímetros.

additionalEntries.name: História
entries: Sua experiência ajuda a identificar objetos cerâmicos, incluindo quando foram criados e seu provável lugar ou cultura de origem.

additionalEntries.name: Investigação, Percepção
entries: Você ganha uma visão adicional ao inspecionar cerâmicas, descobrindo pistas que outros poderiam ignorar ao notar pequenas irregularidades.

additionalEntries.name: Reconstrução
entries: Ao examinar fragmentos de cerâmica, você pode determinar a forma original e intacta de um objeto e seu provável propósito.

additionalEntries.caption: Ferramentas de Oleiro
rows: Determinar o que um recipiente continha
Criar um pote utilizável
Encontrar um ponto fraco em um objeto cerâmico

items.name: Ability:
entries: Intelligence

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Discern what a ceramic object held in the past 24 hours ({@dc 15})

items.name: Craft:
entries: {@item Jug|XPHB}, {@item Lamp|XPHB}

baseitem.name: Ring Mail
entries: Esta armadura é uma armadura de couro com anéis pesados costurados nela. Os anéis ajudam a reforçar a armadura contra golpes de espadas e machados. A cota de anéis é inferior à cota de malha, e geralmente é usada apenas por aqueles que não podem pagar por uma armadura melhor.

baseitem.name: Scale Mail
entries: Esta armadura consiste em uma jaqueta e calças (e talvez uma saia separada) de couro cobertas com peças de metal sobrepostas, muito semelhantes às escamas de um peixe. O traje inclui manoplas.

baseitem.name: Shawm
entries: Um instrumento de palheta dupla semelhante a um oboé ou um fagote, popular entre os gnomos, que desenvolveram algumas versões movidas a fole.

items.name: Ability:
entries: Charisma

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Play a known tune ({@dc 10}), or improvise a song ({@dc 15})

baseitem.name: Shield
entries: Um escudo é feito de madeira ou metal e é carregado em uma mão. Usar um escudo aumenta sua Classe de Armadura em 2. Você pode se beneficiar de apenas um escudo por vez.

baseitem.name: Sling Bullet
entries: Sling bullets are used with a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.
Sling Bullets are typically stored in a {@item Pouch|XPHB} (bought separately).

baseitem.name: Sling Bullets (20)
entries: Sling bullets are used with a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.
Sling Bullets are typically stored in a {@item Pouch|XPHB} (bought separately).

baseitem.name: Smith's Tools
additionalEntries: As ferramentas de ferreiro permitem que você trabalhe com metal, aquecendo-o para alterar sua forma, reparar danos ou transformar lingotes brutos em itens úteis.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: As ferramentas de ferreiro incluem martelos, tenazes, carvão, panos e uma pedra de amolar.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana e História
entries: Sua experiência lhe confere uma percepção adicional ao examinar objetos de metal, como armas.

additionalEntries.name: Investigação
entries: Você pode identificar pistas e fazer deduções que outros podem ignorar quando uma investigação envolve armaduras, armas ou outras obras em metal.

additionalEntries.name: Reparar
entries: Com acesso às suas ferramentas e uma chama aberta quente o suficiente para tornar o metal maleável, você pode restaurar 10 pontos de vida a um objeto de metal danificado para cada hora de trabalho.

additionalEntries.caption: Ferramentas de Ferreiro
rows: Afiar uma lâmina cega
Reparar uma armadura
Destruir um objeto de metal não mágico

entries: Strength

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Pry open a door or container ({@dc 20})

items.name: Craft:

baseitem.name: Songhorn
entries: A recorder, a simple type of flute, usually carved from wood.

baseitem.name: Spiked Armor
entries: A armadura espinhosa é um tipo raro de armadura média feita por anões. Ela consiste em um casaco de couro e calças cobertas com espinhos que geralmente são feitos de metal.

baseitem.name: Splint Armor
entries: Esta armadura é feita de tiras verticais estreitas de metal rebitadas a um suporte de couro que é usado sobre um acolchoado de tecido. Uma cota de malha flexível protege as articulações.

baseitem.name: Studded Leather Armor
entries: Feita de couro resistente, mas flexível, a armadura de couro com rebites é reforçada com rebites ou espinhos próximos uns dos outros.

baseitem.name: Tantan
entries: Um pandeiro, um instrumento popular entre halflings e humanos ao sul das Terras dos Lagos.

baseitem.name: Thelarr
entries: Também conhecido como flautacano, um instrumento de sopro simples e fácil de fazer, cortado de uma junco. Eles são tão simples, na verdade, que bards habilidosos frequentemente os fazem e os dão para crianças—para a alegria ou arrependimento dos pais.

baseitem.name: Tinker's Tools
additionalEntries: Um conjunto de ferramentas de artífice é projetado para permitir que você repare muitos objetos mundanos. Embora você não consiga fabricar muito com ferramentas de artífice, pode consertar roupas rasgadas, afiar uma espada gasta e remendar uma armadura de malha desgastada.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: As ferramentas de artífice incluem uma variedade de ferramentas manuais, linha, agulhas, uma pedra de amolar, pedaços de tecido e couro, e um pequeno pote de cola.

additionalEntries.name: História
entries: Você pode determinar a idade e a origem de objetos, mesmo que tenha apenas algumas peças restantes do original.

additionalEntries.name: Investigação
entries: Quando você inspeciona um objeto danificado, você ganha conhecimento de como ele foi danificado e há quanto tempo.

additionalEntries.name: Reparação
entries: Você pode restaurar 10 pontos de vida a um objeto danificado para cada hora de trabalho. Para qualquer objeto, você precisa de acesso aos materiais brutos necessários para repará-lo. Para objetos de metal, você precisa de acesso a uma chama aberta quente o suficiente para tornar o metal maleável.

additionalEntries.caption: Ferramentas de Artífice

Improvisar um item temporário usando sobras

baseitem.name: Tocken
entries: A hanging set of carved oval bells, usually played with a pair of light wooden hammers (or open handed). They are most common in underground cultures, where the resonant tones can carry.

baseitem.name: Wargong
entries: Um gongo de metal, tradicionalmente feito a partir de um escudo, particularmente o escudo de um inimigo. Tanto goblins quanto anões fabricam e tocam wargongs, cujo som ecoa pelos túneis no Subterrâneo.

baseitem.name: Weaver's Tools
additionalEntries: Ferramentas de tecelão permitem que você crie tecido e o transforme em peças de vestuário.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: Ferramentas de tecelão incluem linha, agulhas e retalhos de tecido. Você sabe como operar um tear, mas esse equipamento é grande demais para ser transportado.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, História
entries: Sua especialização lhe confere uma percepção adicional ao examinar objetos de tecido, incluindo capas e robes.

additionalEntries.name: Investigação
entries: Usando seu conhecimento do processo de criação de objetos de tecido, você pode identificar pistas e fazer deduções que outros poderiam ignorar ao examinar tapeçarias, estofados, roupas e outros itens tecidos.

additionalEntries.name: Reparar
entries: Como parte de um descanso curto, você pode reparar um único objeto de tecido danificado.

additionalEntries.name: Criar Roupas
entries: Supondo que você tenha acesso a tecido e linha suficientes, você pode criar um traje para uma criatura como parte de um descanso longo.

Fazer um traje

baseitem.name: Woodcarver's Tools
additionalEntries: Ferramentas de entalhador permitem que você crie objetos intrincados de madeira, como fichas de madeira ou flechas.

additionalEntries.name: Componentes
entries: Ferramentas de entalhador consistem em uma faca, um goivador e uma serra pequena.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, História
entries: Sua especialização lhe confere uma visão adicional ao examinar objetos de madeira, como estatuetas ou flechas.

additionalEntries.name: Natureza
entries: Seu conhecimento sobre objetos de madeira lhe dá uma visão adicional ao examinar árvores.

additionalEntries.name: Reparar
entries: Como parte de um descanso curto, você pode reparar um único objeto de madeira danificado.

additionalEntries.name: Criar Flechas
entries: Como parte de um descanso curto, você pode criar até cinco flechas. Como parte de um descanso longo, você pode criar até vinte. Você deve ter madeira suficiente em mãos para produzi-las.

rows: Criar uma pequena estatueta de madeira
Entalhar um padrão intrincado na madeira

baseitem.name: Yarting
entries: Um instrumento do sul de Amn e Calimshan que é um análogo faeruniano da guitarra. Várias variações se espalharam pelo continente.

baseitem.name: Yklwa
entries: Uma yklwa (pronunciada YICK-ul-wah) é uma arma de combate corpo a corpo simples que é a arma tradicional dos guerreiros Chultan. Uma yklwa consiste em um cabo de madeira de 3 pés com uma lâmina de aço ou pedra de até 18 polegadas de comprimento. Embora tenha a propriedade de arma arremessada, a yklwa não é bem equilibrada para arremesso.

baseitem.name: Zulkoon
entries: Um complexo órgão de tubos que se originou com os zulkirs de Thay, que o utilizam na conjuração de seus feitiços. É considerado ter um som dramático, mas sinistro.

entries.name: Two-Handed
entries: This weapon requires two hands to use. This property is relevant only when you attack with the weapon, not when you simply hold it.

entries.name: Two-Handed
entries: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

entries.name: Ammunition
entries: You can use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from the weapon. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack. Loading a one-handed weapon requires a free hand. At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.
If you use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a melee attack, you treat the weapon as an improvised weapon. A sling must be loaded to deal any damage when used in this way.

entries.name: Ammunition
entries: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

entries.name: Ammunition
entries: You can use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from the weapon. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack. Loading a one-handed weapon requires a free hand. The ammunition of a firearm is destroyed upon use.
If you use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a melee attack, you treat the weapon as an improvised weapon. A sling must be loaded to deal any damage when used in this way.

entries.name: Ammunition
entries: Firearm Bullets are destroyed upon use in a modern firearm. Futuristic firearms use Energy Cells that become depleted but could possibly be recharged with the proper equipment, at the GM's discretion.

entries.name: Burst Fire
entries: A weapon that has the burst fire property can make a single-target attack, or it can spray a 10-foot-cube area within normal range with shots. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take the weapon's normal damage. This action uses ten pieces of ammunition.

entries.name: Burst Fire
entries: As an action, you can expend 10 pieces of a Burst Fire weapon's ammunition to spray shots in a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within the weapon's normal range. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take damage. Roll the weapon's damage once, and apply it to each creature that failed the save.

entries.name: Finesse
entries: When making an attack with a finesse weapon, you use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

entries.name: Finesse
entries: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

entries.name: Heavy
entries: Creatures that are Small or Tiny have disadvantage on attack rolls with heavy weapons. A heavy weapon's size and bulk make it too large for a Small or Tiny creature to use effectively.

entries.name: Heavy
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

entries.name: Light
entries: A light weapon is small and easy to handle, making it ideal for use when fighting with two weapons.

entries.name: Light
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a {@item Shortsword|XPHB} in one hand and a {@item Dagger|XPHB} in the other using the {@action Attack|XPHB} action and a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} unless that modifier is negative.

entries.name: Loading
entries: Because of the time required to load this weapon, you can fire only one piece of ammunition from it when you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

entries.name: Loading
entries: You can fire only one piece of ammunition from a Loading weapon when you use an action, a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

entries.name: Reach
entries: This weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it. This property also determines your reach for opportunity attacks with a reach weapon.

entries.name: Reach
entries: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} with it.

entries.name: Reload
entries: A limited number of shots can be made with a weapon that has the reload property. A character must then reload it using an action or a bonus action (the character's choice).

entries.name: Reload
entries: You can make a limited number of shots with a Reload weapon. You must then reload the weapon as an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Thrown
entries: If a weapon has the thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack. If the weapon is a melee weapon, you use the same ability modifier for that attack roll and damage roll that you would use for a melee attack with the weapon. For example, if you throw a handaxe, you use your Strength, but if you throw a dagger, you can use either your Strength or your Dexterity, since the dagger has the finesse property.

entries.name: Thrown
entries: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

entries.name: Versatile
entries: This weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property—the damage when the weapon is used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Versatile
entries: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Vestige of Divergence
entries: {@note This item is a Vestige of Divergence, see {@book Vestiges of Divergence|EGW|7|Vestiges of Divergence} for more information.}

entries.name: Treasure (Art Object)
entries: Idols cast of solid gold, necklaces studded with precious stones, paintings of ancient kings, bejeweled dishes—art objects include all these and more.

entries.name: Treasure (Coinage)
entries: Characters often find coins on their adventures and can spend those coins in shops, inns, and other businesses. Coins come in different denominations based on the relative worth of their material. The Coin Values table lists coins and how much they're worth relative to the Gold Piece, which is the game's main coin. For example, 100 Copper Pieces are worth 1 Gold Piece.
A coin weighs about a third of an ounce, so fifty coins weigh a pound.

entries.name: Treasure (Gemstone)
entries: Gemstones are small, lightweight, and easily secured compared to their same value in coins.

entries.name: Artisan's Tools
entries: These special tools include the items needed to pursue a craft or trade. Proficiency with a set of artisan's tools lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make using the tools in your craft. Each type of artisan's tools requires a separate proficiency.

entries.name: Artisan's Tool
entries: Artisan's Tools are each focused on crafting items and pursuing a trade. Each type of Artisan's Tools tools requires a separate proficiency.

If you have proficiency with a tool, add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the check too.

entries.name: Gaming Set
entries: If you are proficient with a gaming set, you can add your proficiency bonus to ability checks you make to play a game with that set. Each type of gaming set requires a separate proficiency.

entries.name: Tool (Gaming Set)
entries: If you have proficiency with a tool, add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the check too.

entries.name: Instrument
entries: If you have proficiency with a given musical instrument, you can add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to play music with the instrument. A bard can use a musical instrument as a spellcasting focus. Each type of musical instrument requires a separate proficiency.

entries.name: Tool (Musical Instrument)
entries: If you have proficiency with a tool, add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the check too.

entries.name: Range
entries: A weapon that can be used to make a ranged attack has a range shown in parentheses after the ammunition or thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second indicates the weapon's maximum range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the weapon's long range.

entries.name: Range
entries: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

entries.name: Crew
entries: A ship needs a crew of skilled hirelings to function. As per the Player's Handbook, one skilled hireling costs at least 2 gp per day. The minimum number of skilled hirelings needed to crew a ship depends on the type of vessel.

You can track the loyalty of individual crew members or the crew as a whole using the optional loyalty rules in chapter 4 of the Dungeon Master's Guide. If at least half the crew becomes disloyal during a voyage, the crew turns hostile and stages a mutiny. If the ship is berthed, disloyal crew members leave the ship and never return.

entries.name: Passengers
entries: This indicates the number of Small and Medium passengers the ship can accommodate.
Accommodations consist of shared hammocks in tight quarters. A ship outfitted with private accommodations can carry one-fifth as many passengers.
A passenger is usually expected to pay 5 sp per day for a hammock, but prices can vary from ship to ship. A small private cabin usually costs 2 gp per day.

entries.name: Cargo
entries: The maximum tonnage the ship can carry.

entries.name: Damage Threshold
entries: If a ship has a Damage Threshold, it has immunity to all damage unless it takes an amount of damage equal to or greater than its damage threshold, in which case it takes damage as normal. Any damage that fails to meet or exceed the damage threshold is considered superficial and doesn't reduce the ship's hit points.

entries.name: Ship Repair
entries: Repairs to a damaged ship can be made while the vessel is berthed. Repairing 1 hit point of damage requires 1 day and costs 20 gp for materials and labor.

entries.name: Speed
entries: A ship sailing against a strong wind moves at half speed. In a dead calm (no wind), waterborne ships can't move under sail and must be rowed. Keelboats and Rowboats are used on lakes and rivers. If going downstream, add the speed of the current (typically 3 miles per hour) to the speed of the vehicle. These vehicles can't be rowed against any significant current, but they can be pulled upstream by draft animals on the shores. A Rowboat can be carried and weighs 100 pounds.

entries.name: Crew
entries: A ship larger than a Keelboat or Rowboat needs a crew of skilled hirelings (see "{@book Services|XPHB|6|Services}") to function. The minimum number of skilled hirelings needed to crew a ship depends on the type of ship.

entries.name: Passengers
entries: The number of Small and Medium passengers the ship can accommodate using hammocks. A ship outfitted with private accommodations can carry one-fifth as many passengers. A passenger usually pays 5 SP per day for a hammock, but prices can vary from ship to ship. A small private cabin usually costs 2 GP per day.

entries.name: Damage Threshold
entries: See the {@variantrule Damage Threshold|XPHB|rules glossary}.

entries.name: Ship Repair
entries: Repairs to a damaged ship can be made while the vessel is berthed. Repairing 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} of damage requires 1 day and costs 20 GP for materials and labor. If the repairs are made in a location where supplies and skilled labor are abundant, such as a city shipyard, the repair time and cost are halved.

entries.name: Tool
entries: If you have proficiency with a tool, add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the check too.

entries.name: Trade Bar
entries: Because large numbers of coins can be difficult to transport and account for, many merchants prefer to use trade bars—ingots of precious metals and alloys (usually silver). These bars are valued by weight.

entries.name: Trade Good
entries: Most wealth is not in coins. It is measured in livestock, grain, land, rights to collect taxes, or rights to resources (such as a mine or a forest).

Guilds, nobles, and royalty regulate trade. Chartered companies are granted rights to conduct trade along certain routes, to send merchant ships to various ports, or to buy or sell specific goods. Guilds set prices for the goods or services that they control, and determine who may or may not offer those goods and services. Merchants commonly exchange trade goods without using currency.

entries.name: Trade Good
entries: Merchants commonly exchange trade goods without using currency.

itemTypeAdditionalEntries.name: Gaming Set
entries: Proficiency with a gaming set applies to one type of game, such as Three-Dragon Ante or games of chance that use dice.

entries.name: Components
entries: A gaming set has all the pieces needed to play a specific game or type of game, such as a complete deck of cards or a board and tokens.

entries.name: History
entries: Your mastery of a game includes knowledge of its history, as well as of important events it was connected to or prominent historical figures involved with it.

entries.name: Insight
entries: Playing games with someone is a good way to gain understanding of their personality, granting you a better ability to discern their lies from their truths and read their mood.

entries.name: Sleight of Hand
entries: Sleight of Hand is a useful skill for cheating at a game, as it allows you to swap pieces, palm cards, or alter a die roll. Alternatively, engrossing a target in a game by manipulating the components with dexterous movements is a great distraction for a pickpocketing attempt.

entries.caption: Gaming Set
rows: Catch a player cheating
Gain insight into an opponent's personality

itemTypeAdditionalEntries.name: Instrument
entries: Proficiency with a musical instrument indicates you are familiar with the techniques used to play it. You also have knowledge of some songs commonly performed with that instrument.

entries.name: History
entries: Your expertise aids you in recalling lore related to your instrument.

entries.name: Performance
entries: Your ability to put on a good show is improved when you incorporate an instrument into your act.

entries.name: Compose a Tune
entries: As part of a long rest, you can compose a new tune and lyrics for your instrument. You might use this ability to impress a noble or spread scandalous rumors with a catchy tune.

entries.caption: Musical Instrument
rows: Identify a tune
Improvise a tune

itemEntry.name: Absorbing Tattoo
entriesTemplate: Produced by a special needle, this magic tattoo features designs that emphasize one color ({{item.detail1}}).

entriesTemplate.name: Tattoo Attunement
entries: To attune to this item, you hold the needle to your skin where you want the tattoo to appear, pressing the needle there throughout the attunement process. When the attunement is complete, the needle turns into the ink that becomes the tattoo, which appears on the skin.
If your attunement to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes, and the needle reappears in your space.

entriesTemplate.name: Damage Resistance
entries: While the tattoo is on your skin, you have resistance to {{item.resist}} damage.

entriesTemplate.name: Damage Absorption
entries: When you take {{item.resist}} damage, you can use your reaction to gain immunity against that instance of the damage, and you regain a number of hit points equal to half the damage you would have taken. Once this reaction is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

itemEntry.name: Armor of Resistance
entriesTemplate: You have resistance to {{item.resist}} damage while you wear this armor.

itemEntry.name: Armor of Resistance
entriesTemplate: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage while you wear this armor.

itemEntry.name: Chromatic Rose
entriesTemplate: While this rose is held, it {{item.detail1}} as a harmless visual effect.

While holding the rose by its stem, you gain resistance to {{item.resist}} damage. If you would take more than 10 {{item.resist}} damage from a single source (after applying the resistance), the rose disintegrates, and you take no damage instead.

As an action, you can blow the petals from the rose to produce a 20-foot cone of {{item.resist}}. Each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 3d10} {{item.resist}} damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Using this property destroys the rose.

itemEntry.name: Dragon Scale Mail
entriesTemplate: Dragon Scale Mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them. Other times, hunters carefully preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, Dragon Scale Mail is highly valued.

While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the breath weapons of Dragons, and you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage.

Additionally, you can focus your senses as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to discern the distance and direction to the closest {{item.detail1}} dragon within 30 miles of yourself. This action can't be used again until the next dawn.

itemEntry.name: Grenade
entriesTemplate: As an action, a character can throw a grenade at a point up to 60 feet away. With a grenade launcher, the character can propel the grenade up to 120 feet away.

itemEntry.name: Grenade
entriesTemplate: As an action, you can either throw a grenade at a point up to 60 feet away or use a Grenade Launcher to propel the grenade to a point up to 1,000 feet away. The grenade explodes at that point, creating a particular effect in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}.

itemEntry.name: Ioun Stone
entriesTemplate: Roughly marble sized, {@i Ioun Stones} are named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of {@i Ioun Stones} exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

When you take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to toss an {@i Ioun Stone} into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of {@dice 1d3} feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three {@i Ioun Stones} orbiting your head at the same time.

Each {@i Ioun Stone} orbiting your head is considered to be an object you are wearing. The orbiting stone avoids contact with other creatures and objects, adjusting its orbit to avoid collisions and thwarting all attempts by other creatures to attack or snatch it.

As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can seize and stow any number of {@i Ioun Stones} orbiting your head. If your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to an Ioun Stone ends while it's orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

itemEntry.name: Potion of Resistance
entriesTemplate: When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to {{item.resist}} damage for 1 hour.

itemEntry.name: Potion of Resistance
entriesTemplate: When you drink this potion, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage for 1 hour.

itemEntry.name: Ring of Resistance
entriesTemplate: You have resistance to {{item.resist}} damage while wearing this ring. The ring is set with {{item.detail1}}.

itemEntry.name: Ring of Resistance
entriesTemplate: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage while wearing this ring. The ring is set with {{item.detail1}}.

itemEntry.name: Scroll of Protection
entriesTemplate: Using a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to read the scroll creates a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. For 5 minutes, {{item.detail2}} can't enter or affect anything in the area. However, if you move in such a way that an {{item.detail1}} would be inside the area, the effect ends.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, a creature within 5 feet of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} can attempt to overcome it, which forces the creature to make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the creature ceases to be affected by the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

itemMastery.name: Cleave
entries: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

itemMastery.name: Graze
entries: If your attack roll with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier.

itemMastery.name: Nick
entries: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the {@action Attack|XPHB} action instead of as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

itemMastery.name: Push
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

itemMastery.name: Sap
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

itemMastery.name: Slow
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

itemMastery.name: Topple
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 8} plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

itemMastery.name: Vex
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.
